publisher: MVO project; first-party measurement, not an independent certification
evidence_scope: One resumed, previously paired WhatsApp session in one instrumented PHP process; one run

runtime_source_fingerprint.scope: src/ and resources/ from the distribution accompanying this report; not a Git commit

collection.process_metrics: System.Diagnostics.Process.TotalProcessorTime, WorkingSet64, PrivateMemorySize64; only the PHP PID, observer excluded
collection.php_metrics: memory_get_usage(false), memory_get_usage(true), memory_get_peak_usage(true); message/node callback counters
collection.instrumentation: Callbacks and JSONL snapshots are included in PHP process measurements; observer PowerShell CPU/memory are excluded
collection.php_clock: hrtime timer started inside PHP script after interpreter initialization
collection.clock_alignment: Offset not captured. Original numerical cutoff uses connected PHP elapsed + 35 on both clocks; windows are not perfectly synchronized.
collection.collector_report_provenance: Console completion report; not derived from CSV sample span
collection.original_phase_idle_meaning: Name of script phase after 15 seconds connected; does not mean zero traffic
collection.messages_meaning: Observed message callbacks, including possible sync/replay/fromMe; not necessarily unique new incoming messages

window_selection.startup: OS rows elapsed_seconds <= 0.887 + 15; phase initial includes sync/warmup, not login duration

units_and_formulas.working_set: Resident process pages, private and shared; not exclusive physical RAM cost per session
units_and_formulas.private_commit: Private Bytes / private committed memory, not private resident RAM
units_and_formulas.php_heap: Zend allocator used/reserved memory; not all native allocations, not additive to working set
units_and_formulas.cpu_percent_machine_32_logical: cpu_percent_one_core / 32; normalized process utilization, not measured total host CPU
units_and_formulas.peak_cpu_percent_one_second: Legacy key: maximum interval-average CPU between consecutive selected OS samples (~1 s), not instantaneous peak
units_and_formulas.memory_median: Unweighted median of selected sample values
units_and_formulas.summary_rounding: Window seconds 3 decimals; CPU seconds 5; core CPU percent 4; machine CPU percent 5; interval CPU percent 3; OS memory MiB 2; PHP MiB recorded at 3

reproduction.original_collectors: reproduce/session-resource-probe.php, reproduce/measure-session.ps1, reproduce/summarize-session-resources.py are byte-for-byte copies used for this measurement
reproduction.original_assumptions: Windows / PowerShell 7; C:/xampp/php/php.exe; .dev/php.ini; scripts copied to workspace .cache; session default already linked and no other worker; fixed output .cache/resource-probe-live
reproduction.original_aggregator_limit: Metadata Windows, PHP 8.4.25 and 32 logical processors are hardcoded; not portable environment discovery
reproduction.offline_audit: python docs/benchmarks/2026-10-14/reproduce/recalculate.py; standard library only, verifies summary against CSV and distributed SHA-256 hashes
reproduction.chart: reproduce/plot.py; matplotlib 3.11.2 used, Manrope fonts from docs/assets/fonts; SVG paths need no font download

limits: No marginal RAM estimate by multiplying working sets
publication_transforms: CSV contains only explicit allowlisted numeric fields and phase; row order and numeric values preserved
Public summary omits local session label, renames received_* counters to message/node events, adds sampling metadata
No credentials, keys, JIDs, message content or database files distributed
